contexts.text: Poisons poured out by evil Spirits.
To pour out (or shed) the blood of man in man () = to extinguish charity.
His blood shall be poured out () = his condemnation. AC 1012.
Be ye poured out in the earth () = increase of good in the external man. To be poured out is predicated of goods. Explained.
The spirit is said to be poured out () upon lower truths and goods, when they accede and confirm.
To pour out innocent blood = to violate what is holy. Illustrated.
Shalt pour it out upon the dry () = immission into the Natural.
An outpouring into all things there. Signified. AC 7683.
Prayers which they then ardently pour forth fundunt.
To pour out blood = to inflict violence on truth Divine... Explained. AC 9127:5. Illustrated. AC 9262:4. AC 9264:end.
Their thought pours itself out into the universe without determination.
Thou shalt pour upon his head (). Explained.
To pour () = to communicate.
To pour is predicated of liquids... and to pour out, of Divine, celestial, and spiritual things.
Unless the affection pours out into acts...
To pour out the blood () = to falsify the truths of the Word; thus to pervert them. AE 975.
The mind can be effused, and can effuse itself...
Their Subject could effuse an idea...
To pour out innocent blood = to destroy the good of love and of charity. Illustrated.
The effusion of innocent blood = the adulteration of the Word as to its truths.
The influx of Heaven into those who are being reformed, is signified by, the spirit shall be poured out upon you from on high ().
